[Act: technology
 Chapter: Penalties, Compensation and Adjudication5
 Section: 45::Residuary penalty.
]


Whoever contravenes any 4[rules, regulations, directions or orders] made under this Act, for the contravention of which no penalty has been separately provided, shall be liable to pay a 5[penalty not exceeding one lakh rupees, in addition to compensation to the person affected by such contravention not exceeding—
(a) ten lakh rupees, by an intermediary, company or body corporate; or
(b) one lakh rupees, by any other person.]
